d: Kya travankor men sach men Breast Tax lagta tha? mulakkaram ka asli matlab kya tha, nangeli ka nam kisi purane sarkari Record men kyon nahin milta, BBC se lekar Chief Justice tak ye kahani kaise pahunchi, channar aandolan men nadar aurton ke sath aur kallumala aandolan men dalit pulyar aurton ke sath asal men kya huaa.. is Video men 1937 ki travankor sarkar ki kitab, videshi yatriyon ke byore, manu es pillai jaise itihaskaron ki bat aur 1859 ke shahi hukm ke sahare puri kahani, donon pakshon ke satha.
